scope: Offline result interpretation only; no physical, solver, clinical or control thresholds changed

recovery.rationale: Electric restoration confirms on any positive actual service interval; heat/cold require a fixed 60 seconds of continuous original non-material-shortage delivery to reject instantaneous finite-energy bridges. This fixed reporting time is independent of event/integration step and the old 1s equivalence band, and is not a temperature or clinical standard.
recovery.candidate: Actual end of original material shortage, retained even when unconfirmed
recovery.confirmation: Candidate plus carrier-specific uninterrupted confirmation horizon
recovery.union: Union of overlapping affected-carrier pending confirmation windows; electricity retains zero confirmation delay
clocks: absolute actual service-resumption candidate and subsequent confirmation
signed offset and nonnegative wait after external fault clearance
signed offset and nonnegative wait after actual applicable source restoration

comparison.ENS_scope: Every priority/carrier separately; retain original raw values and six critical cells without carrier compensation
comparison.money_rule: max(0.01 USD2001, 1e-6 * larger raw cost); a reporting unit for illustrative monetary inputs, not measurement accuracy
comparison.CO2_rule: max(0.01 kg, 1e-6 * larger raw conditional CO2); same registered factor and boundary required
comparison.inventory_rule: Each store separately max(0.001 kWh, 1e-6 * capacity or initial DG shaft-work-equivalent budget); identical initial stock and scale required
comparison.inventory_tradeoffs: All terminal stores and fee form one noncompensating vector; no invented salvage value or energy exchange
comparison.unknowns: Missing/censored evidence stays unknown; no-interruption N/A is not recovery zero
comparison.pair_scope: Only explicitly listed runs with identical complete scenario and effective physical configuration, different policy, same model/source/input binding and unchanged source/input bytes; failed or drifted attempts remain visible but cannot enter formal ranking
